newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan 97/98 development budget at 95 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan 97/98 development budget at 95 bln rupees.

text.p: Pakistan has allocated 95.106 billion rupees for public development spending in fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), up from a revised programme of 85.153 billion in 1996/97, the Annual Plan for 1997/98 said.

The Plan, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Friday, said the original public sector development budget allocation of 104.8 billion rupees, reduced from a requirement of 146 billion rupees, had been cut to 85.2 billion in October.
A further 20 billion rupees was slashed from the federal development spending element in the programme, reducing it to 59.7 billion from 79.3 billion, it added.
"The whole portfolio was thoroughly reviewed and a number of new and non-starter and politically motivated non-viable schemes were dropped," the document said.
